generation_method: compiled from the checked-in source and extracted from the ELF .text section; this proves Clang PPC32 integer ABI behavior, not devkitPPC byte identity
command: clang --target=powerpc-none-eabi -mcpu=750 -mbig-endian -O2 -ffreestanding -fno-builtin -fomit-frame-pointer -c ppc_eabi_frame_call.c -o ppc_eabi_frame_call.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text ppc_eabi_frame_call.o ppc_eabi_frame_call.bin
